title: 15 NEW MSFS Activities Dropped! Airline Schedules, River Tours & A320 Missions
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just dropped a massive wave of 15 new activity packs and operational add-ons for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. Whether you want to command scheduled Airbus A320 operations across remote Alaskan wilderness, inject authentic international summer timetables into major global hubs, or throttle back for low-and-slow river discovery flights across Europe and Eurasia, this drop brings serious replay value to your simulator. We divide the breakdown into four distinct categories:

✈️ Curated Commercial Collections & Special Editions: We explore high-value multi-packs and commemorative drops, starting with Perfect Flight’s 12 Legs Spring 2026 Master Collection for the iniBuilds A320 V2—bundling previously released United and Spirit packs with custom events, authentic sounds, and discounted bundle pricing. We also spotlight the America 250 Alaska Airlines special edition, featuring 12 challenging IFR missions navigating from remote gravel communities and the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta down through Seattle and the Inside Passage.

📅 Global Airline Fleet Schedules: A comprehensive look at summer schedule timetable expansions across five major global carriers: Allegiant Air, China Airlines, Iberia, LATAM Airlines, and Oman Air. We review the authentic real-world route networks and liveries, alongside important buyer reminders regarding base aircraft dependencies.

🌍 International Hub Traffic Overhauls: Timetable and livery injections designed to populate airport gates with realistic airline operations. This week's featured airports include Vancouver International (CYVR), Vienna (LOWW), Oakland (KOAK), Kuwait (OKBK), and Kuala Lumpur (WMKK).

🗺️ Scenic Discovery & VFR Excursions: Throttle back for low-altitude scenic touring. We take the Pilatus PC-6 along the winding course of the Danube River from Freiburg to Cataloi with Koschi’s multi-language adventure tour, explore New Jersey’s barrier beaches and Atlantic City with Perfect Flight’s 7-leg narrated audio guide, and trace Europe’s longest river in the Beechcraft Bonanza G36 with World Rivers 12: Adventure Volga.

Whether you're executing complex commercial rotations in the A320 or flying low and slow along the world's most famous waterways, this marketplace release has plenty of flying to keep your logbook full.

Drop a comment below and let me know: Which of these routes or schedules are you flying first? Make sure to hit the like button, subscribe to High in the Flightsim Sky for weekly flight simulator updates, and clear skies on your next flight!
